plain: An exchange in which each side gives the other equal benefits

webster.text: Reciprocal obligation or right; equal mutual rights or benefits to be yielded or enjoyed.

example.quote: He conceived that the contiguity of some states, and remoteness of others, would prevent that reciprocity which he had mentioned.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 18, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
